description: This file defines the WalkieTalkieActivity class, which manages SIP call functionality, UI interactions, and configurations for an Android walkie-talkie application. It handles registration with the SIP server, making and receiving calls, and user interface updates.

classes.name: WalkieTalkieActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing SIP registration, calls, and user interactions for the WalkieTalkie app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, intent filters, and SIP manager.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Re-initializes SIP manager when activity starts.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters receiver, and closes SIP profile.

methods.name: initializeManager
methods.description: Creates SIP manager instance if not already initialized.

methods.name: initializeLocalProfile
methods.description: Logs into SIP provider, registers device with SIP server using stored preferences.

methods.name: closeLocalProfile
methods.description: Unregisters and frees SIP profile resources.

methods.name: initiateCall
methods.description: Starts an outgoing SIP call to the specified address.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates UI with current SIP status message.

methods.name: updateStatus (overloaded)
methods.description: Updates UI with the peer's call information.

methods.name: onTouch
methods.description: Handles push-to-talk button touch events for muting/unmuting.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu options for calling, settings, and hanging up.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu options selection for calling, updating settings, or hanging up.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs for entering call address and updating SIP settings.

methods.name: updatePreferences
methods.description: Launches activity for user to edit SIP account settings.
